styleGuide.name: The Maths Habit Unified Style
styleGuide.description: Cohesive modern educational style bridging vibrant context images with clean colourful diagrams

promptPrefixes.context: Vibrant, modern 3D render / photography style. British context. Clean composition, warm lighting, soft background blur. High quality, suitable for educational app.
promptPrefixes.diagram: Modern educational diagram. Light grey or white background. Primary blue lines (#4A90D9). Orange labels for measurements (#F59E0B). Purple for unknowns (#8B5CF6). Clean sans-serif font. Subtle shadow/depth.
promptPrefixes.hybrid: Realistic scene with clean geometric overlay. Blue lines and shapes layered on photograph/render. Labels clearly visible. Mathematical meets real-world.

N1.prompt: Four different sized glass juice bottles on a white supermarket shelf, warm lighting. Bottles arranged smallest to largest: Small (orange juice, £1.50 price tag), Medium (red berry juice, £2.50), Large (yellow tropical juice, £3.50), Family size (purple grape juice, £5.00). Each bottle has a clean white label with the size name and cute fruit icons. Price tags are small rounded rectangles below each bottle. Soft blurred supermarket background. Modern product photography style, vibrant colours.

N2.prompt: Modern clean diagram showing ocean depth cross-section. Gradient blue background from light (surface) to darker (deep). Horizontal line at top labelled 'Sea Level 0m' in dark grey. Vertical depth scale on left in orange: 0, -20, -40, -60, -80, -100. Cute cartoon-style yellow submarine with simple details. Blue dashed arrows showing movement: up arrow labelled '+18m', down arrow labelled 'dive'. Depth markers at -45m, -27m, -81m with small orange labels. Clean, friendly educational style.

N6.prompt: Bird's eye view diagram of a square garden. Light green fill for grass area. Blue outline for the square border. Small brown circles representing wooden fence posts, 8 evenly spaced along each side. Orange dimension arrow along one side showing '12 m'. Corner posts slightly larger. Subtle shadow under the garden. Clean white background. Modern flat design with slight depth.

N7.prompt: 3D isometric diagram of two cubes - large transparent cube containing smaller solid cube. Large cube: light blue edges (like glass/wireframe), dimensions '5 m' in orange on three visible edges. Small cube inside: solid warm wood texture or tan colour, '2 m' labels in orange. Soft shadow beneath. Clean white background. Modern technical illustration style, friendly not sterile.

N8.prompt: Modern British bus stop scene with two colourful buses. Red double-decker bus labelled 'Route A' and blue single-decker labelled 'Route B' at a contemporary glass bus shelter. Digital clock display showing '9:00 AM'. Timetable board visible showing departure times. Bright daylight, clean urban setting. Friendly, inviting atmosphere. Slight depth of field blur on background buildings.

N12.prompt: Bright, modern clothing shop window display. Large 'SALE 15% OFF' sign in red and white. Stylish jacket on mannequin torso, original price tag showing '£80' crossed out, new price '£68' in bold. Warm lighting, contemporary boutique feel. Clean composition with soft bokeh lights in background. British high street aesthetic, aspirational but accessible.

N13.prompt: Top-down floor plan diagram of empty rectangular room. Light warm wood flooring texture. Blue outline walls. Orange dimension arrows: '4.5 m' along length, '3 m' along width. Small carpet roll icon in corner showing carpet texture. Grid overlay very faintly suggesting square metres. Clean white border. Modern architectural plan style with warmth.

N16.prompt: Aerial photograph style view of rectangular green field. White measurement poles at corners. Orange tape measure lines along two edges showing '≈12 m' and '≈8 m' with wavy lines suggesting approximation. Surveying equipment (theodolite on tripod) visible at one corner. British countryside setting with hedgerows at edges. Warm golden hour lighting. Professional but accessible.

A1.prompt: Friendly British plumber in clean blue overalls standing by white van. Holding a wrench, smiling. Clipboard in other hand showing invoice: 'Call-out fee: £30, Hourly rate: £__'. Van has cheerful logo. Residential driveway setting with British house in background. Warm, trustworthy atmosphere. Modern lifestyle photography style.

A2.prompt: Clean coordinate graph on light grey grid background. Blue axes with arrow heads, labelled 'h (metres)' vertical 0-20, 't (seconds)' horizontal 0-4. Smooth orange parabola curve from origin, peaking at (2, 20), returning to (4, 0). Key points marked with blue dots. Formula 'h = 20t - 5t²' in purple italic text. Small ball icon at peak. Modern educational graph style.

A5.prompt: 3D diagram of cylindrical water tank, semi-transparent blue showing water inside. Clean blue outline. Orange dimension arrows: radius '3 m' across top with dashed line from centre, height '7 m' along side. Small right angle symbol where radius meets edge. Soft shadow beneath. Light grey background. Modern technical illustration, friendly feel.

A7.prompt: Classic black British taxi cab on a London-style street. Illuminated orange 'TAXI' sign on roof. Digital meter display visible through window showing fare calculation. Red brick buildings softly blurred in background. Evening lighting with warm street lamps. Modern cinematic style, slightly nostalgic but contemporary.

A9.prompt: Coordinate grid with light grey gridlines on white background. Blue axes from -2 to 8 on both axes, with arrow heads. Blue line segment from point A to point B. Point A marked with blue dot at (2, 7), labelled 'A(2, 7)' in dark grey. Point B at (6, -1), labelled 'B(6, -1)'. Small zipline icon or person silhouette on the line. Modern clean graph style.

A15.prompt: Coordinate graph with dark navy background suggesting night sky. Light grey grid. White/silver axes labelled. Golden/orange parabola curve showing firework trajectory, subtle sparkle effects along curve. Crosses x-axis at -1 and 3. Peak at (1, 4) with small starburst. Equation 'y = (x-3)(x+1)' in white text. Beautiful, slightly magical feel while still being mathematical.

A17.prompt: Modern British cinema foyer with red carpet and warm lighting. Ticket counter with illuminated price board: 'TICKETS - Adults: £x, Children: Half Price'. Family of five (3 adults, 2 children) at counter, seen from behind. Popcorn stand visible to side. Contemporary multiplex feel, exciting atmosphere. 'Total: £36' shown on till display.

A19.prompt: Cosy British café table from above. Two coffee cups (white ceramic with coffee) and two tea cups (with tea, different style cups). Receipt on table showing partial totals. Chalkboard menu blurred in background showing 'Coffee £? Tea £?'. Warm lighting, wooden table surface. Hygge aesthetic, inviting and relatable. Small 'Order 1' and 'Order 2' labels.

A21.prompt: Theme park ride entrance with colourful height measuring board. Vertical ruler marked 100-220 cm. Bracket at 120 cm with green 'MIN' label, bracket at 200 cm with red 'MAX' label. Green zone highlighted between them. Exciting roller coaster track visible in background. Bright, fun atmosphere. Safety-focused but exciting.

A23.prompt: Bird's eye view of theatre seating arrangement. Elegant red velvet seats arranged in curved rows. Row 1 (front) with 15 seats, Row 2 with 19 seats, Row 3 with 23 seats, Row 4 with 27 seats - numbers shown as small labels. Stage rectangle at front in gold/brown. Warm theatre lighting ambiance. Sophisticated but clear diagram. Slight 3D perspective.

A26.prompt: Bird's eye view diagram combining illustration with grid. Circular fountain with blue water and central spray. Coordinate grid overlay with blue axes, origin at fountain centre. Bench icon at position (5, 12) with label. Grass texture around fountain, path crossing through. Park setting with trees at edges. Clean labels showing coordinates. Modern illustrated map style.

R2.prompt: Hands holding an Ordnance Survey style map. Focus on a blue lake on the map. Clear ruler measuring across lake showing '3.2 cm'. Map legend visible with 'Scale 1:50,000'. British countryside map with contour lines, footpaths, green areas. Warm natural lighting. Outdoor adventure feeling, practical context.

R4.prompt: Three happy diverse friends holding coloured raffle tickets triumphantly. Behind them a banner: '£270 PRIZE WINNER!'. First person holds 2 blue tickets, second holds 3 red tickets, third holds 4 green tickets (2:3:4 ratio visual). Celebratory atmosphere, confetti in air. Community hall or fete setting. Joyful, relatable.

R5.prompt: Cute animal shelter scene. Clean, modern shelter interior. One side shows 6 cats (various colours) in cosy spaces, other side shows 10 dogs (various breeds, friendly looking). Glass partition between. 'Cats' and 'Dogs' signs above each section. Warm, caring atmosphere. Numbers subtly visible. Heartwarming, not sad.

R7.prompt: Large hotel lobby being painted by decorators in white overalls. Paint cans, ladders, dust sheets visible. Some workers actively painting. Progress chart on easel showing 'Day 3 of 8'. Professional but friendly atmosphere. Grand staircase partially covered. British hotel interior style. Warm lighting through large windows.

R14.prompt: Modern delivery van (white/branded) driving on British motorway. Inside view showing dashboard: satnav display with '180 km' distance and '2h 15min' time, speedometer visible. Driver's hands on wheel. Sunny day, green countryside beyond motorway. Motion blur suggesting movement. Professional delivery company aesthetic.

G1.prompt: 3D cube diagram on light grey background. Blue edges for visible lines, blue dashed for hidden edges. Vertices marked with small orange dots, labelled A-H in dark grey. Three callout labels with arrows: 'Vertex' pointing to corner, 'Edge' pointing to side, 'Face' pointing to surface (surface has very light blue tint). Subtle shadow beneath. Clean, modern, educational.

G3.prompt: Top-down diagram of a roundabout with three roads. Clean design: grey circular roundabout in centre, three white roads extending outward. Angles between roads marked with blue arcs. Two angles labelled '127°' and '85°' in orange. Third angle marked '?' in purple. Road markings simplified. Modern traffic diagram style, clean and clear.

G4.prompt: Top-down diagram of railway tracks crossing a road. Clean design: two parallel grey railway lines crossing a white road diagonally. Four angles at intersection marked with blue arcs. One angle labelled '65°' in orange. Other three marked '?' in purple. Level crossing markings simplified. Clean technical style with subtle texture.

G5.prompt: Top-down view of a 15-sided polygon (approximate) representing stone patio. Light grey/sandstone texture fill. Blue outline. One interior angle marked with blue arc and '156°' label in orange. Small tick marks on a few sides showing equal lengths. Green garden texture around edges with flower illustrations. Modern landscape diagram style.

G8.prompt: Retro-modern video game screen style. Pixel art character on coordinate grid (0-8 both axes). Blue grid lines on dark background. Character at position P(2, 5) with label. Blue arrow showing movement to (6, 2). Vector notation '(4, -3)' in orange. Small sparkle trail along path. Fun gaming aesthetic combined with maths, appealing to teens.

G9.prompt: Coordinate grid with clean blue axes. Triangle shape (like a logo) with vertices at (1,1), (3,1), (2,4) in solid teal colour. Dashed blue diagonal line for y = x, labelled. Reflected triangle on other side in lighter teal/transparent. Vertices labelled A, B, C and A', B', C'. White background. Modern graphic design meets mathematics.

G11.prompt: Top-down view of circular wooden table (warm wood texture). Clean blue circle outline overlaid. Centre marked 'O' with small dot. Horizontal chord drawn across. Radius line from centre to edge: '10 cm' in orange. Perpendicular dashed line from centre to chord: '8 cm' in orange. Small right angle square. Chord length marked '? cm' in purple. Modern diagram on realistic base.

G13.prompt: Side view diagram of grain silo - cylinder with cone roof. Slight 3D effect with subtle shading. Blue outlines. Cylinder body with orange labels: 'radius = 3 m' at base, '6 m' height. Cone roof: '4 m' height. Dashed blue centre line. Warm farm background softly visible (fields, blue sky). Modern technical illustration with context.

G14.prompt: Bird's eye view of triangular flower bed in garden setting. Colourful flowers filling the triangle. Blue coordinate grid overlay. Vertices at (1,2), (5,2), (3,6) labelled A, B, C in dark grey. Grid squares visible with '1 m' scale noted. Green lawn texture around. Orange dimension indicators. Beautiful garden meets mathematics.

G15.prompt: Garden pond from above - circular with lily pads and koi fish visible. Blue water. Person's hands visible holding measuring tape around circumference, showing '31.4 m'. Centre point marked. Radius line drawn with 'r = ?' in purple. Lush garden setting around pond. Beautiful, practical context for circle maths.

G16.prompt: Single pizza slice on white plate, photographed from above at slight angle. Pepperoni pizza, appetising. Blue geometric overlay: two lines from point (crust centre) to crust edges, labelled '15 cm' in orange. Arc (crust) labelled '12 cm' in orange. Angle at point marked 'θ = ?' in purple. Delicious meets mathematical. Clean, modern food photography.

G19.prompt: Side view diagram of ladder against brick wall. Realistic textures: red brick wall, wooden ladder, paved ground. Blue triangle overlay showing the geometry. Labels in orange: '5 m' along ladder, '1.5 m' along ground. '? m' in purple for height. Small blue right angle square in corner. Safety context - hard hat icon in corner. Modern safety diagram style.

G20.prompt: British village scene with stone church tower. Surveyor with modern equipment at marked point. Blue dashed line from surveyor to tower top. Orange labels: '50 m' along ground, '32°' for angle of elevation. Height of tower marked 'h = ?' in purple. Warm lighting, picturesque village setting. Professional surveying meets charming context.

P2.prompt: Clear cellophane sweet bag on white surface. Contains exactly 3 red strawberry sweets and 7 brown cola bottle sweets, all clearly visible and countable. Sweets have shiny wrapper texture. Small labels or thought bubble: '3 strawberry, 7 cola'. Hand reaching toward bag. Bright, appealing product style. Tempting but mathematical.

P6.prompt: Modern Venn diagram on light background. Two overlapping circles: left one coral/orange with pizza slice icon and 'Pizza' label, right one blue with burger icon and 'Burgers' label. Numbers in each region clearly visible. Outside region labelled 'Neither'. Rectangle border labelled '30 students'. Friendly infographic style, colourful but clear.

P7.prompt: Restaurant table setting with three coins showing mix of heads and tails. Colourful promotional tent card: 'FLIP FOR YOUR DISCOUNT!'. Stylised tree diagram overlay showing branches for H/T outcomes. Eight final outcomes listed neatly (HHH, HHT, etc.). Fun restaurant promotion atmosphere. Engaging and mathematical.

P8.prompt: Colourful lucky dip tub at a summer fete. Festive decorated barrel with wrapped prizes inside - clearly showing 4 red wrapped and 6 blue wrapped gifts. Two excited children's hands reaching in. Bunting and fair decorations in background. Joyful, summery atmosphere. British fete setting.

S2.prompt: Modern infographic style pie chart. Colourful segments for different sports with icons: Football (largest, orange, football icon, 108°), Basketball (teal), Tennis (purple), Swimming (blue). Clean white background. Labels around edge. Title 'Favourite Sports - 60 students'. Angle marking shown on football segment. Contemporary data visualisation style.

S4.prompt: Clean line graph on light grey grid. Blue axes: 'Time (hours)' 0-2.5 horizontal, 'Distance (km)' 0-100 vertical. Orange line graph: steep rise to 60km at 1hr, flat line (stop) until 1.5hr, steep rise to 100km at 2hr. Small delivery van icons at key points along line. Modern infographic style, clear and educational.

S5.prompt: Five diverse teenagers standing together, each holding smartphone. Speech bubbles above showing screen time: '8 hrs', '10 hrs', '?', '14 hrs', '15 hrs'. Large text: 'Mean = 12 hours'. Modern, relatable teens in casual clothing. Bright, contemporary style. Social media/tech aesthetic that resonates with young people.

A2.prompt: 3D open cardboard box diagram, isometric view. Realistic cardboard texture. Blue edge highlights. Three dimensions labelled in purple (algebra): '(2x + 3)' length, '(x - 4)' width, '(x + 1)' height. Soft shadow beneath. Clean white background. Modern product/packaging illustration style with mathematical overlay.

A13.prompt: Beautiful mosaic wall pattern with triangular arrangement. Mediterranean/Roman style colourful tiles. Rows clearly visible: Row 1 = 5 tiles, Row 2 = 12 tiles, Row 3 = 23 tiles, Row 4 = 38 tiles. Small labels showing counts. Warm terracotta and blue tile colours. Artistic yet mathematical, showing quadratic sequence visually.

A15.prompt: Clean coordinate graph, light grey grid. Blue axes with labels. Orange parabola curve for y = x² - 4x + 5. Teal straight line for y = 2x - 3. Point of intersection/tangency highlighted with purple dot and coordinates. Both equations labelled in matching colours. Modern mathematical graph style, clear and elegant.

A17.prompt: Sports field background (green grass, white lines). Football trajectory shown as orange parabola arc from kicker. Peak marked at '20 m' height with 't = 2s' label. Landing point at 't = 4s'. Faint coordinate axes overlay. Small footballer silhouette at origin. Dynamic sports photography merged with mathematical diagram.

A24.prompt: Coordinate graph with stadium/sky background. Axes: 't (seconds)' 0-5, 'h (metres)' 0-25. Orange parabola from origin, peak at (2, 20), returning to x-axis at (4, 0). Key points marked with dots and labels. Dashed vertical line at maximum. Football icon at peak. Modern sports science aesthetic.

G1.prompt: Beautiful regular 9-sided polygon tile pattern. Moroccan/Mediterranean style with rich blues and golds. One central tile highlighted with blue geometric overlay. Interior angle marked with arc and '140°' in orange. Equal side tick marks. Warm, artistic photograph merged with clean geometry. Elegant and educational.

G3.prompt: Bird's eye garden plan. Trapezium-shaped flower bed filled with colourful flowers (roses, lavender). Blue geometric outline overlay. Parallel sides labelled '8 m' and '12 m' in orange. Height shown as dashed perpendicular with 'h = ?' in purple. Right angle squares. 'Area = 50 m²' label. Beautiful garden design meets geometry.

G5.prompt: Side-by-side 3D diagrams: ice cream style cylinder and cone. Same base radius and height shown with matching dimension lines. Cylinder labelled 'Volume = 300π cm³' in orange. Cone labelled 'Volume = ?' in purple. Soft ice cream colours (vanilla/cream). Modern product illustration style. Appealing and mathematical.

G9.prompt: Clean sector diagram (pizza slice shape). Warm pizza-like colour or neutral geometric fill. Blue outline. Two radii labelled '12 cm' in orange. Arc labelled '15 cm' in orange. Angle at centre marked 'θ = ? radians' in purple. Small mathematical notation hints. Modern clean style with subtle warmth.

G11.prompt: 3D cuboid (box shape) with semi-transparent faces. Blue edges. Dimensions: '3 cm', '4 cm', '12 cm' in orange on visible edges. Space diagonal drawn as purple dashed line through interior from corner to opposite corner, labelled 'd = ?'. Subtle 3D shading. Clean modern technical illustration.

G15.prompt: 3D composite shape: hemisphere dome on cylindrical base (like a water tank or capsule). Semi-transparent or wireframe style. Blue outlines. Shared radius '6 cm' labelled in orange. Cylinder height '10 cm' labelled. Surface area shading indicated. Soft shadow. Modern technical illustration with slight industrial context.

G19.prompt: Modern office building with glass windows. Surveyor with equipment at marked position. Two dashed blue sight lines: one to window (lower), one to roof (higher). Labels: '50 m' ground distance, '38°' angle to window, '62°' angle to roof. Window height 'h = ?' in purple. Professional urban surveying context.

P5.prompt: Colourful charity stall game board. Large die visible. Prize board showing rules in clear boxes: 'Roll 6 → Win £10' (green), 'Roll Odd → Win £2' (blue), 'Roll Even (not 6) → Lose £3' (red). Friendly fairground aesthetic. Probability values shown: '1/6', '3/6', '2/6'. Fun but mathematical.

P6.prompt: Two decorative boxes on magician's table. Box A open showing 3 red and 5 blue cards visible. Box B showing 4 red and 2 blue cards. Curved arrow showing card moving from A to B. Probability tree diagram overlay to the side. Magic show atmosphere with purple velvet. Mysterious yet clear diagram.

S2.prompt: Modern statistical diagram with two horizontal box plots on same scale (0-100). Top plot: 'Class A' with median at 62, small box (IQR 15). Bottom plot: 'Class B' with median at 58, larger box (IQR 24). Clean blue and teal colouring. Scale clearly marked. Contemporary data visualisation style. Clear comparison focus.

S3.prompt: Scatter graph with light grey grid. Axes: 'Hours Studied' (x, 0-10), 'Exam Mark %' (y, 0-100). Blue dot markers showing positive correlation. Orange line of best fit through points. Equation 'y = 2.3x + 15' labelled. Small student studying icon in corner. Modern educational data viz style.
